localSourceProof.injection: UTF-8 universal-newline read; exactly the two literal Handler connect-src substitutions; exactly one validated local-engine application/json block before the first closing head. No other script, scientific content or stylesheet is removed or normalized.

checks: unknown unit actively rejects recommendation with zero cards/Apply actions
occupied artwork append preserving original source and edits, one Undo/Redo
untouched blank replace with declared paired data, one Undo/Redo
private table value blocked on search click
explicit public literature click intercepted without external transmission; offline error preserves local previews
current explicitly supplied standalone offline summary render and apply

privacy.externalTransmission: Blocked by the browser harness before transmission. No literature response or citation is fabricated.

scope: Existing discovery UI and local rules, exercised with the repository independent/paired/summary CSV engineering fixtures. Actual file upload, recommendation, application, history, persistence, SVG/PNG exports and an explicit current standalone-file offline flow. This is not a study of clinical validity or a successful online literature retrieval.
installation: Runtime kind is explicit. Installed package/Setup identity requires the independent Windows installer sidecar; source acceptance alone does not prove an installed binary.
